tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Use when you have a product's name, domain or kind in mind: send a short query ('stripe.com', 'postgres', 'invoicing') with filters for category, agent level, access or payment. Returns the products we drove, sorted by agent level (0-5), each with where our agent stopped; a task in plain words: choo

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Use when you are about to use or recommend a product and need to know if an agent can work it on its own: send its slug from search_tools, or its name or domain. Returns its drive result: agent level (0-5), where our agent stopped, what it can and can't do, how it gets in and pays; only its API, MCP

tools.name: get_agent_surfaces
tools.description: Use when you picked a product and need to wire it up: its API, MCP server, CLI, SDK, docs and payment, each tested, documented, none_found or unknown, with the product's own URL for it and the date we saw it. The whole drive result: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; about 1 KB.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Use when you need a valid category id for choose_provider_for_task, search_tools or get_category: every category with its id, name, number of products and best agent level (0-5). Read-only, no key needed; no arguments.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Use when you know the category and want a shortlist: its name, how many products AgentDrives drove in it, the best agent level (0-5) and its top 10 by level, each with its drive date and page. The rest: search_tools with the same category. Read-only, no key needed.

tools.name: list_best_providers
tools.description: Use when asked "which provider works best for X?" in a category: its driven products ranked by agent level (0-5), each with where our agent stopped, and how many we drove in it; under 5, not enough drives yet. Then get_provider for one product. Read-only, no key needed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: choose_provider_for_task, get_agent_surfaces · Private data: choose_provider_for_task · Public sink: choose_provider_for_task, search_tools, get_provider, compare_providers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: choose_provider_for_task, get_agent_surfaces · Private data: choose_provider_for_task · Public sink: choose_provider_for_task, search_tools, get_provider, compare_providers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
